thread:
Aisha (Marketing): quick sync — we want to announce the feature launch tomorrow. Need: final changelog link, docs URL, canary timing, webinar CTA + registration link, and inbound lead routing. Can eng confirm rollout window and any gradations?
Drew (Engineering): changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/482 — includes notes on model pinning and batching defaults.
Drew (Engineering): rollout plan: canary at 10:00 PT -> 2 hours observation -> gradual ramp to 50% at 12:30 PT -> full by 15:00 PT. Will keep a fallback to v1 model for 30m on errors.
Aisha (Marketing): sweet — can we lock the canary window? marketing needs the exact start for the countdown and the webinars team needs the failover plan.
Drew (Engineering): locking now. Feature flag: rf_launch_2026.ops = true at 10:00 PT. If latency > 400ms p95 for 5m, auto-rollback to v1.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Drew for 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). Health checks: latency, error_rate, kvcache-fill.
Liam (Docs): docs live at https://docs.redwood.com/release/2026-03-launch — added an anchor for "model-pinning" and "batching-tips". Sending the shortlink for marketing: https://rwd.io/launch-mar-24
Priya (Product): Messaging bullets for the announcement: 1) Predictable inference with model pinning; 2) Lower unit costs via automatic batching; 3) Easy rollouts with canary + auto-fallback. We should include a small benchmark line (p95 latency drop at 30% cost) — marketing, ok?
Aisha (Marketing): yes — we'll craft a single-sentence benchmark and link to a deeper benchmark blog. Also planning a webinar at 11:30 PT on launch day — 30m demo + 15m q&a. CTA to registration: https://events.redwood.com/launch-mar24
Aisha (Marketing): inbound routing question — can we route signups from the webinar and launch page to SDR queue 'launch-24' and tag by region?
ops-oncall: yes. We'll create a temporary routing rule in HubSpot: source=launch-mar24 -> queue=launch-24; add tag region from IP / form field. Ops will monitor lead flow for first 24h.
Drew (Engineering): quick note: embedding endpoints will have a short maintenance window at 12:00 PT for a microconfig tweak (30s). No expected user impact, but flagging in case webinar demo uses embeddings.
Aisha (Marketing): thanks — we'll avoid embedding-heavy flows in the demo during that minute.
Liam (Docs): updated the docs snippet for the changelog: "See changelog PR #482 for full details — includes breakouts for API changes, SDK knobs, and recommended rollout settings."
Priya (Product): checklist: docs link? yes. changelog? yes. canary + rollback? yes. webinar link + slide deck? Marketing will share final deck by 9:00 PT tomorrow. Lead routing rule? Ops to confirm completion here.
ops-oncall: rule created and tested in staging. Will promote at 09:30 PT tomorrow and post confirmation here.
Aisha (Marketing): perfect. One last ask — embargo for public release? We plan to go live at 10:00 PT when canary starts. Marketing will press the announce button at 11:45 PT (right before webinar). Confirm?
Drew (Engineering): that's fine. We'll keep the canary monitor and signal channel #release-monitor open. If anything triggers rollback, please hold the announce.
Aisha (Marketing): got it. I'll post the pre-announcement notes to ops and the GTM channel at 09:50 PT. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): tagging product support to stand by for early inbound questions.
Liam (Docs): leaving a short FAQ snippet here for marketing to copy: "How do I pin a model? See docs -> Model pinning section with examples and SDK snippet."
Aisha (Marketing): thanks all. If anyone spots anything missing ping me directly.
Drew (Engineering): adding a tiny note — we bumped autoscaler buffer for the first 3 hours to avoid noisy scaling during ramp.
ops-oncall: confirmed routing promoted at 09:32 PT; monitoring dashboard shared to #gtt-launch; will update if anomalies.
